items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for bounded reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced, but missing telemetry is not evidence of safety. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics data quality is yellow because source permissions or collector errors remain; unavailable data must not be treated as zero. No certificate is reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS safety. Exact decision: preserve private and parked gates; block public exposure and security-sensitive releases; permit only bounded reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix only. Do not access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue unchanged work, or conduct outreach.

Continue the existing security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate work.

Do not admit public exposure or security-sensitive releases until dated evidence covers access boundaries, secret handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and disclosure readiness. Reconsider only after fleet-doctor and operations sweeps produce results and material unknowns are resolved.
